lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming approximately four identifiable horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular blobs, creating a rectilinear grid-like appearance on the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct longitudinal feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are visible on the rightmost section of the visible flank, defined by high-contrast shadowed regions.
